notes: Light of Promise, printed: 'Enchanted creature has "Whenever YOU gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature."' The granted ability's 'you' is its controller, the controller of the enchanted creature (CR 113.8, 109.5). Your Light of Promise on the opponent's 2/2: when YOU gain 3 life nothing happens; when the OPPONENT gains 3 life on their turn, their creature gets 3 +1/+1 counters.
